protocol_amendment: Independent balanced target and label schedules; fair random and recency baselines over the same candidate set; every candidate block beyond the frozen model's 24-layer rolling receptive field; exact source identity required for resume.
hypothesis: With the fixed 32-token task prompt visible in every condition and supporting evidence beyond the multilayer rolling receptive field, one causally relevant natural-language block at a fixed one-block historical budget reduces frozen-model answer loss relative to rolling-only, random-block, and recency-block attention.
